description: This PHP class, SearchViewMetaDataParser, is a parser for search view metadata in a SuiteCRM module, extending ListLayoutMetaDataParser. It handles constructing and manipulating search view metadata layouts, validating fields, converting between search view types, and saving modifications.

classes.name: SearchViewMetaDataParser
classes.description: A parser class for search view metadata layouts, extending ListLayoutMetaDataParser, used to manage search view configurations, including validation, conversion, and saving of search layouts within SuiteCRM modules.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the parser with the specific search layout type, module, and optional package, loading and standardizing view definitions.

methods.name: isValidField
methods.description: Determines if a field is valid for inclusion in the search layout, considering type, studio settings, and specific field rules.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Saves the current search layout configuration, optionally populating data from a request, and deploying changes.

methods.name: convertSearchViewToListView
methods.description: Converts search view definitions into a list view format compatible with other parts of the system.

methods.name: normalizeDefs
methods.description: Normalizes field definitions into a lowercased associative array indexed by field name.

methods.name: getOriginalViewDefs
methods.description: Retrieves and normalizes the original view definitions, merging basic and advanced search definitions if applicable.
